source_extracts.label: eCFR 31 CFR 1020.220(a)(2)(i)(A) — CIP address requirement
source_extracts.quote: Address, which shall be: For an individual, a residential or business street address ... For a person other than an individual (such as a corporation, partnership, or trust), a principal place of business, local office, or other physical location

source_extracts.label: Ohio SOS Form 610 — Articles of Organization
source_extracts.quote: Agent Address - Post office boxes and CMRAs are NOT allowed. See instructions for details. ... Articles of Organization for a Domestic Limited Liability Company Filing Fee: $99

source_extracts.label: Ohio SOS Form 521 — Statutory Agent Update
source_extracts.quote: Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) addresses are NOT allowed. A CMRA is a private business that rents private mailboxes to customers.

source_extracts.label: Google Business Profile guidelines — Address
source_extracts.quote: Use a precise, accurate address and/or service area to describe your business location. P.O. boxes or mailboxes located at remote locations aren't acceptable. ... If your business rents a physical mailing address but doesn't operate out of that location, also known as a virtual office, that location isn't eligible for a Business Profile. ... If you're a service-area business, you should hide your business address from customers.

source_extracts.label: USPS DMM 508.1.8.3 — CMRA addressing
source_extracts.quote: Mailpieces must bear a delivery address that contains at least the following elements, preferably in the following format: Line 2 'PMB' and number...

source_extracts.label: USPS CMRA FAQ — Form 1583 and IDs
source_extracts.quote: CMRA = private business that rents PMBs and accepts mail from USPS for distribution; Form 1583 + two forms of ID (one photo) required
